scope: Outcome-Loop v2: Beta posterior confidence replaces additive delta (prior retrospective validation: r_pb=-0.05, p=0.66, DEAD). Pre-registered validation on 468 qualifying production runs. New: use-attribution p_used param (use_count column), selectivity gate p_min_score on all recall functions, match_confidence calibration guidance.
justification: Pre-registered gate PASSED on production data (r_pb=+0.20, p=0.008, held-out test set 45/423). Base-rate-adjusted scheme: r_pb=+0.277, p=0.0003, chi²=0.008 (all gates PASS). Caveats per pre-registration: chi² median-split NS (p=0.47), power=29% at test-set size. Evidence grade: MODERATE. Temporal confound (run_order→outcome) p=0.055 NS — no longer dominant. Default pgmnemo.confidence_boost_weight remains 0.0 (conservative for external adopters); activation guide in USAGE.md.
schema_change_detail: New column agent_lesson.use_count INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 (backfill: success_count+fail_count). New GUCs: pgmnemo.confidence_mode ('posterior'|'additive'), pgmnemo.confidence_prior_alpha (default 1.0), pgmnemo.confidence_prior_beta (default 1.0). New reinforce() 3-param overloads (p_used BOOLEAN). p_min_score REAL DEFAULT NULL added as last param to recall_hybrid (11th), recall_fast (7th), recall_lessons (9th), recall_lessons_pooled (4th). All additive with DEFAULT NULL — zero call-site changes required.
scoring_impact: p_min_score: no impact when NULL (default, backward-compatible). When set, filters rows where match_confidence < threshold before ORDER BY/LIMIT — reduces result set size without reordering survivors. confidence_boost_weight default 0.0 unchanged — no ranking change for default installs.
recall_ranking_impact: none for default installs (confidence_boost_weight=0.0, p_min_score=NULL). p_min_score filtering is caller opt-in and does not change ORDER BY key for retained rows.
backward_compat_proof: t_backward_compat pg_regress test (T1-T6): 2-param reinforce() shims delegate to 3-param form (p_used=NULL→TRUE); param counts verified; use_count column present and backfilled. p_min_score NULL-default verified bit-identical to 0.12.x recall paths.

caveats: chi² median-split NS (p=0.47) — primary scheme passes r_pb and p gates
power=29% at test-set size — larger test set would reduce uncertainty
temporal confound run_order→outcome p=0.055 NS (was p<0.01 in the prior retrospective validation)
pre_registered_validation.release_decision: SHIP with conservative default (confidence_boost_weight=0.0); activation guide in USAGE.md
